history.dynasty: Undocumented; local listings claim it is the 'oldest temple of Karnal' — unverified
history.period: Build date and founders not documented in searchable sources; complex still being expanded per visitor reviews
history.summary: Shri Mata Durga Bhavani Bada Mandir in Shakti Colony, near the Karnal bus stand, is the city's major Durga temple (CSV name 'Durga Bhawani Mandir' matches; note the documented spelling is 'Bhavani'). Per detailed visitor reviews: a large complex with separate pooja halls for Lord Hanuman and Mata Durga, a central hall housing Ram Darbaar, Radha-Krishna, Lakshmi-Narayan and Mata Saraswati, an Akhand Jyot of Maa Jwala Ji kept burning just outside the temple hall, sculptures of many rishis, and a garden; construction work was still in progress at the time of reviews. Directory listings describe it as a heritage/oldest temple of Karnal, but no dated history or founder is documented — treat the antiquity claim as unverified. Reportedly wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking.

name: Shri Mata Durga Bhavani Bada Mandir
town_description: Karnal, on the GT Road in Haryana's National Capital Region, is traditionally associated with Karna of the Mahabharata (a large statue of him stands in the city). It is an agricultural-trade centre known for its dairy research and agricultural institutes.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi (~130 km)
travel.road: Shakti Colony, near Karnal Bus Stand, Karnal 132001 (plus code MXQQ+V5W)
